_comment: Attribute extraction + validation catalog. The 'HOW' of Semantic Extraction AND the 'rules' of Truth Validation. Which attributes are REQUIRED is decided by the rater (RaterTemplateAgent); this file describes how to extract/interpret/validate each one. Edit freely without touching code. Override the path with nebag_ATTRIBUTE_CATALOG_PATH. dtype: string | number | integer | boolean. constraints: {required, min, max, allowed, pattern}.

insured_name.description: Legal name of the insured entity

annual_revenue.description: Most recent annual revenue in USD

industry.description: Primary industry / sector of the insured

prior_claims_count.description: Number of prior claims in the lookback period
